{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''Richard Alan Wentworth''' is an American mathematician based at the [[University of Maryland]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.math.umd.edu/~raw/|title=Richard A. Wentworth|publisher=[[University of Maryland]]|access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

Wentworth received his Ph.D. from [[Columbia University]] in 1990, where he was supervised by [[Duong Hong Phong]]. He took his BS from the [[University of Wisconsin]] in 1985.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=37821|title=Richard Wentworth}}</ref>

In 2012, Wentworth became a [[Fellow of the American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |url=http://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi |publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]] |access-date=4 September 2025 |quote=Wentworth, Richard Alan, University of Maryland - 2013 |archive-date=7 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210207151427/http://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi |url-status=dead }}</ref> He has served as Editor-in-Chief of ''[[Geometriae Dedicata]]'' since January 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=Geometriae Dedicata |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10711 |website=[[SpringerLink]] |access-date=4 September 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
